annotations.title: Treasury, SOFR, Fed funds, prime and mortgage rates

description: Latest value, observation date, week-ago and month-ago readings and freshness status for 1 to 8 rate series (Treasury par curve 1-month to 30-year, SOFR and its 30/90/180-day averages, effective Fed funds, bank prime, Freddie Mac 30- and 15-year mortgage), read from the publishers' feeds the site refreshes daily. Optionally adds up to 365 days of daily history.

history_days.description: Days of daily history to include (0 to 365, default 0). Series x days is capped at 400.

ids.description: Series ids, e.g. ["UST10","SOFR"]. Allowed: UST1M, UST3M, UST6M, UST1, UST2, UST3, UST5, UST7, UST10, UST20, UST30, SOFR, SOFR30, SOFR90, SOFR180, EFFR, PRIME, PMMS30, PMMS15.

name: rate_series
